project_description: Refactor Go-LIP's extension architecture so frontend, backend, provider, and connector growth has additive rather than Cartesian maintenance cost: replace FE×BE completeness gates with contract TCK certification plus a bounded integration sentinel, make compatible inference providers data-driven profiles of a small number of protocol families, single-source plugin contribution metadata, prevent protocol-specific backend-plugin ABI growth, remove confirmed continuation mirrors, and add architecture/change-surface ratchets while preserving canonical routing, streaming, failover, security, and current wire behavior.
